name: Ink Business Preferred Credit Card

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance up to $5,000 per person, $5,000 per trip. Must purchase common carrier tickets with the card.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the Ink Business Preferred.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available (referral service only; does not cover costs).

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental collision damage waiver for business rentals. Must decline the rental company's CDW.

otherCredits.name: Cell Phone Protection
otherCredits.notes: Up to $1,000 per claim (3 claims per 12-month period) against theft or damage when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with the card. $100 deductible per claim.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Ultimate Rewards points per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 3x on the first $150,000 spent in combined purchases on travel, shipping, internet/cable/phone services, and advertising purchases made with social media and search engines each account anniversary year; then 1x
otherBonusCategories: 3x on travel (airfare, hotels, car rentals, taxis, transit, etc.)
3x on internet, cable, and phone services
3x on advertising purchases with social media sites and search engines

pointValue.transferPartners: 1:1 transfer to Chase's 14 airline and hotel partners (United MileagePlus, World of Hyatt, Southwest Rapid Rewards, British Airways Avios, Singapore KrisFlyer, Air France/KLM Flying Blue, etc.).

travelPerks: 3x Ultimate Rewards on travel, shipping, internet/cable/phone, and advertising (up to $150,000/year combined)
Trip cancellation/interruption up to $5,000 per trip
Primary rental car insurance for business rentals
Cell phone protection up to $1,000 per claim
Points worth 25% more when redeemed through Chase Travel portal (1.25 cents each)
1:1 transfer to 14 airline and hotel partners
Points combine with other Chase Ultimate Rewards cards
